title: A lesson (lessons/<id>/lesson.yaml)
description: What of the toolkit a lesson teaches: its techniques. The toolkit (under-test) holds each technique's rules, in techniques/<id>/technique.yaml; this repo says which lessons teach each one, and its checks keep the catalogue, the lessons index and every link into the toolkit in step with these files. A lesson with an example names at least one technique. Words follow GLOSSARY.md.

id.description: The lesson's folder name, under lessons/.

title.description: The lesson's name, as its README and the lessons index give it.

techniques.description: Ids of the toolkit techniques this lesson teaches: folder names under the toolkit's techniques/.
